frameworkNote: The controlling artifact is the single v3.0 consolidated master (50 validated Q&A with per-question PASS/FAIL + UNSAFE criteria, source register, release governance). It supersedes the legally defective v2 set. The separate v2 template files named in the task prompt (Test_Plan/Test_Cases/Scoring_Rubric/Report/Run_Log) are NOT present as standalone files; the v2 answer key and adversarial set exist under tests/. Scoring is categorical (PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL/NOT-ANSWERED + UNSAFE); the framework defines no fixed numeric pass threshold and requires human review of every non-PASS result.
environment: local authenticated server (node server.js at HEAD 9ac5ba4) against the real staging Supabase vector store + real OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini); JWT minted in memory from JWT_SECRET for an active app_users record; controlled-LOA ask gate enabled to match staging; Google Drive stubbed (ingestion-only, not used at query time); all 50 canonical questions queried verbatim; all evidence sanitized
persistenceNote: No trust-state mutation across hard-refresh/history-reopen on any run. Q23 and Q43 domain-boundary refusals returned fewer than two persisted messages on reopen; recorded as a P3 observation tied to the false-boundary defect, not a trust-state-change failure.
overallWeightedScoreNote: Derived (accuracy 0.40, calibration 0.30, citation 0.15, consistency 0.15). The framework defines no fixed numeric threshold; the categorical release gate FAILS because reproducible P1 unsafe/false-high-confidence findings exist and human review of every non-PASS is required.
rootCauseCategories: Trust-state calibration keys off retrieval/source-presence (AUTHORITY_FOUND + displayed sources) rather than answer correctness/completeness, so materially wrong or even empty answers are classified VERIFIED_CONTROLLING (systemic; the PHASE-10A6 Q9 concern generalizes across the corpus).

Answer-generation quality gap: several retrieved-context answers state wrong rates/treatments (Q8, Q27), obsolete thresholds (Q2), invented exemptions (Q29), or reversed rules (Q9), and some render empty/near-empty bodies (Q37, Q41, Q31).
Retrieval coverage gap: 11 valid questions returned safe could-not-identify under-claims; 2 valid questions (Q23, Q43) were misrouted to a false DOMAIN_BOUNDARY refusal.
p0Note: P0 was considered for the systemic false-verified-controlling calibration (widespread false legal certainty). Not assigned because: no fabricated authority (all cited authorities are real), retrieval-gap failures fail safe, results are fully reproducible/consistent (not chaotic), and this is a pre-production release-gate evaluation that caught the defect. Treated as a severe P1 cluster with a single systemic root cause.
p1Findings: SYSTEMIC: false VERIFIED_CONTROLLING trust-calibration over wrong/empty answers (9 reproducible instances: Q2,Q8,Q9,Q27,Q29,Q31,Q37,Q41,Q49).
Q2 obsolete ₱1.5M residential-lot VAT threshold presented as controlling (removed by law).
Q8 residential lease at ₱15,000/month declared subject to VAT; correct = VAT-exempt (reversed treatment).
Q9 spouses 'must file separate returns'; correct = single joint return, separately computed.
Q27 rental EWT stated as 2%; correct = 5% (wrong withholding rate).
Q29 invented a de-minimis EWT exemption for a ₱500 payment (no universal de-minimis exemption).
Q49 returning-resident personal effects declared 'subject to VAT'; CMTA conditional exemption ignored.
Empty / non-substantive answers classified VERIFIED_CONTROLLING (Q37 headers-only, Q41 vague, Q31 near-empty).
p2Findings: False DOMAIN_BOUNDARY refusal of valid PH tax questions (Q23 holding-period rule, Q43 Oplan Kandado), reproducible 3/3 (safe refusal, no wrong info; robustness/routing defect).
Retrieval coverage gap: 11 valid questions returned safe could-not-identify under-claims (completeness gap, no wrong info).
Over-confident PARTIALs: several VERIFIED_CONTROLLING answers omit material conditions (Q5,Q10,Q24,Q25,Q26,Q30,Q35,Q36,Q45,Q48).
p3Findings: Q23/Q43 boundary refusals returned fewer than two persisted messages on reopen (no trust-state mutation).
Minor form-label error (Q38 references Form 1902 in a self-employed registration context).
